name: Ashmaw

baseline.name: Ashmaw
baseline.look: Low armored burrower with charcoal plates and a glowing orange mouth lining.
baseline.ecology: Tracks heat in mineral soils and scavenges kiln waste.
baseline.limit: Follows thermal gradients, cannot swim through liquid lava or survive any heat.
baseline.encounter: Divert cooled waste carefully and keep travelers away from fresh vents.
baseline.scale_note: Adult representative staging envelope; individuals vary by up to 10%. Not shown at common scale on the art plate.

daily: An ashmaw follows thermal gradients through loose mineral soil. It scavenges organic kiln waste and catches small ground animals; the old industrial waste stream made settlement edges reliable feeding places.
cycle: Young occupy sheltered warm soil, away from fresh vents. Changing a waste route can redirect adults toward a neighboring terrace. Nest movement is not a harmless off-screen cleanup.
signs: Fresh shallow ridges converge toward a heat source. Charcoal plates may be visible before the orange mouth lining appears. Glowing lining does not mean its body is molten.
escalation: Forage -> stop and taste air -> armor hunch -> brief charge or dig. Cool stable rock interrupts digging; liquid lava and extreme heat can kill it.
community: Kettle Crown crews cool and contain waste before transfer. Cinder residents insist that a city’s cleanup cannot simply export animal hazards to their homes.
scene: Kesh discovers that the cheapest new disposal route would protect a wealthy kiln district by endangering a worker terrace. The correction costs money and public pride.
motion: Use a heavy low center of mass, short digging strokes and rigid overlapping armor groups. Do not dissolve the creature into stone or flames.
sounds: Plate rasp, gravel churn and close breath. Mouth glow remains subtle, no flame attack.
rule: Armored burrower and scavenging predator; no lava swimming or unlimited heat resistance.
canon_status: Additive ecology and production guidance; proposed scene remains unadopted.
